label: Imgflip
description: Arcade tools designed for LLMs to interact with Imgflip

tools.name: CreateMeme
tools.description:
Create a custom meme using an Imgflip template

This tool creates a custom meme by adding your text to an existing
meme template. You can specify top and bottom text, choose fonts,
and control text sizing.

parameters.name: template_id
parameters.description: The meme template ID to use for creation, from a meme template listing or search result.

parameters.name: top_text
parameters.description: Text to display at the top of the meme. Defaults to an empty string (no top text).

parameters.name: bottom_text
parameters.description: Text to display at the bottom of the meme. Defaults to an empty string (no bottom text).

parameters.name: font
parameters.description: Font family to use for the text. Defaults to impact.

parameters.name: max_font_size
parameters.description: Maximum font size for the text. Defaults to 50.

parameters.name: no_watermark
parameters.description: Remove the Imgflip watermark. Defaults to False.

tools.name: GetPopularMemes
tools.description:
Get popular meme templates from Imgflip

This tool retrieves a list of popular meme templates that can be used
to create custom memes. These templates are ordered by popularity
based on how many times they've been captioned.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of meme templates to return. Defaults to 20.

tools.name: SearchMemes
tools.description:
Search for meme templates by query

This tool searches through Imgflip's database of over 1 million meme templates
to find ones that match your search query.

What this tool provides:
- Search results matching your query
- Template information including IDs, names, and URLs
- Caption count to show popularity
- Ready-to-use template IDs for meme creation

When to use this tool:
- When you're looking for specific meme types or themes
- When you want to find memes related to particular topics
- When you need a specific meme format that's not in popular memes
- When you want to discover niche or specialized meme templates

When NOT to use this tool:
- Do NOT use this if you just want the most popular meme templates
- Do NOT use this to create a meme; it only finds templates

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Search query to find meme templates. Be specific for better results.

parameters.name: include_nsfw
parameters.description: Include not-safe-for-work memes in search results. Defaults to False.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of meme templates to return. Defaults to 20.

summary:
Arcade's Imgflip toolkit lets LLMs interact with the [Imgflip](https://imgflip.com) API to discover meme templates and generate captioned memes programmatically.

## Capabilities

- **Template discovery** — retrieve the most popular meme templates ordered by usage, or search Imgflip's database of 1M+ templates by keyword to find specific themes or niche formats
- **Meme creation** — generate a captioned meme from any template ID, with control over top/bottom text, font choice, and text sizing
- **Template metadata** — every result surfaces the template ID, name, preview URL, and caption count, making it easy to chain discovery into creation

## Secrets

This toolkit requires Imgflip account credentials. Register for a free account at [imgflip.com/api](https://imgflip.com/api).

- **`IMGFLIP_USERNAME`** — your Imgflip account username, set during registration at [imgflip.com/signup](https://imgflip.com/signup). Required to authenticate meme-creation API calls.
- **`IMGFLIP_PASSWORD`** — the password for that same Imgflip account. The Imgflip API accepts credentials as plain POST parameters; no token exchange is involved.

Store both secrets in Arcade using the [Arcade secrets guide](https://docs.arcade.dev/en/guides/create-tools/tool-basics/create-tool-secrets) or add them directly via the [Arcade dashboard](https://api.arcade.dev/dashboard/auth/secrets).
